title: Shockable cardiac arrest
summary: A soldier collapsed after a blast wave hit him in the chest. He is not breathing and has no pulse. You have an AED, IO access and resuscitation drugs.
objectives: Recognise cardiac arrest: no response, no breathing, no pulse
Start CPR at once and keep pauses short
Pads on, analyze, shock when advised, then straight back to CPR
IV epinephrine (and amiodarone for VF) through an IO
Secure the airway (i-gel lets CPR and BVM run together)
Return of circulation and SpO2 above 90 % at the end
